During operation, DGSG-Mind applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to long-term scene representation: object instances; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are deliberately linked or jointly consumed by downstream reasoning, generation, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 8): During inference, the operative memory component (long-term scene representation: object instances) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, fixed-rule correction of stored state, explicit deletion or eviction of stored items, relinking or reindexing of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
